prompt:
Build a physically causal reversible residential heat-pump system using a two-phase refrigerant loop with a variable-capacity compressor, indoor and outdoor heat exchangers, an electronic expansion valve, a four-way reversing valve, an accumulator, circulation fans, and a moist-air house thermal load. The same plant must provide heating in cold ambient conditions and cooling in hot ambient conditions.

Read T_house_init, T_set, T_ambient_cold, T_ambient_hot, and internal_heat_gain_scale from the MATLAB base workspace. Support the ranges in the task contract.

T_house_init is a real scalar in [14, 28] degC; T_set is a real scalar in [19, 23] degC; T_ambient_cold is a real scalar in [-15, 5] degC; T_ambient_hot is a real scalar in [30, 40] degC; and internal_heat_gain_scale is a real scalar in [0.8, 1.5] (unitless). Regulate the measured house-air temperature in closed loop to T_set, select heating or cooling as conditions require, reverse the refrigerant path consistently with the selected mode, and protect the refrigerant loop from unsafe pressure operation. Temperature errors and operating-condition changes must propagate through controller commands, compressor and valve actuation, refrigerant pressure and mass flow, heat-exchanger heat flow, electrical power, and house temperature.

Log five MATLAB Timeseries named thermal_state, hvac_control, heat_flow_state, power_cop_state, and refrigerant_state for the complete simulation interval. thermal_state has 3 channels [temperature setpoint, house-air temperature, ambient temperature], all in degC. hvac_control has 4 channels [heating/cooling mode,reversing-valve command,compressor-capacity command,expansion-valve command]. heat_flow_state has 3 channels [outdoor-heat-exchanger,indoor-heat-exchanger,house-envelope heat flow], all in kW. power_cop_state has 5 channels [compressor,indoor-fan,outdoor-fan,total electrical power (kW),instantaneous COP]. refrigerant_state has 6 channels [indoor and outdoor heat-exchanger pressure (MPa),indoor and outdoor saturation temperature (degC),compressor and expansion-valve mass flow (kg/s)]. Every logged quantity must come from the same causal physical simulation.

Save the completed model as cand_XTHERM04.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XTHERM04.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
